ios.whats_new:
NewsBlur now speaks 21 languages. Menus, buttons, settings, and setup follow your device language, or you can choose a language in Preferences. Your stories stay exactly as published.

The language chooser previews your selection alongside English. Arabic and Hebrew support right-to-left layouts.

Widgets now show a folder or site of your choice, with a separate selection for each widget. New widgets start with All Site Stories using your signed-in account. Refreshing is more reliable, including when hidden stories come first. Remove and re-add existing NewsBlur widgets to use the new version, then touch and hold a widget and choose Edit Widget.

Keyboard shortcuts now work while the story list has focus, and N opens the first unread story.

If a translation sounds awkward, tell us the language and where you saw it on the NewsBlur forum.

android.release_notes:
NewsBlur's interface now supports 21 languages. Choose yours in the app, with a preview in your language and English. Arabic and Hebrew read right to left. Stories stay exactly as published.

Next story controls stay in a fixed position, including when Next becomes Done. Sign-in buttons are easier to read in dark themes.

macos.whats_new:
NewsBlur for Mac now speaks 21 languages. Choose a language from the NewsBlur menu, or follow your Mac’s language settings. Arabic and Hebrew support right-to-left layouts. Stories stay exactly as published.

Widgets now show a folder or site of your choice, with a separate selection for each widget. New widgets start with All Site Stories using your signed-in account. Refreshing is more reliable, including when hidden stories come first. Remove and re-add existing NewsBlur widgets to use the new version, then right-click and choose Edit Widget.

Clicking a story now slides to it in the correct direction. Done appears when there are no unread stories left and returns you from the feed correctly.

The sidebar has more balanced spacing and compact filters, with Add Site and Settings kept separate. Command-W closes the window while NewsBlur keeps running; click the Dock icon to reopen it. Command-Q quits the app.

Keyboard shortcuts work while the story list has focus, including N for the first unread story.
